reasoning_content:
The user is getting a white screen when accessing the site. This is likely a frontend issue - either:
1. Frontend build has errors and isn't serving properly
2. Nginx isn't configured to serve the static files
3. The client/frontend isn't being served

Let me check what's happening.

import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check nginx config
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cat /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/arelorian.de 2>&1 | head -20")
print("Nginx config:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check if client dist exists
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls /opt/areloria/client/ 2>&1 | head -10")
print("\nClient dist:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check errors
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -20 /var/log/nginx/error.log 2>&1")
print("\nNginx errors:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
